description.value: Free on-demand reaction ferry (current-propelled) operated by Dawson Road Maintenance under contract to the BC Ministry of Transportation and Transit, crossing the Fraser River about 72 km west of Clinton. Crossing takes about 10 minutes; runs on demand across three daily windows (roughly 7 am–7 pm with breaks), no reservation needed. BC's Ministry of Transportation and Transit treats all inland ferries as an extension of the provincial highway system, mandated to accommodate all legal road users, including cyclists — bikes and e-bikes both ride free and unboxed. When water is low or icy, the ferry is replaced by an aerial tramway for passengers only — whether a bike can ride the tramway is unconfirmed, so check ahead if travelling outside the open-water season.
